goal: Trim the dead halves of two partially live modules and shrink the CLI wrapper surface, without touching either module's live half. Remove the loop_contract.ts child-output validators superseded by deterministic QA and native verdict parsing, and the plan_core.ts fast-track and migration-signature helpers whose only callers were deleted with the v3 island. Delete bin/imm-activation-plan, which today exits with an unknown-command error and no guidance, and collapse the eight retired wrappers -- imm-autowork, imm-check-child-output, imm-finish, imm-heal, imm-migrate, imm-review, imm-route, and imm-work -- into a single stub that preserves today's retirement message. imm-kernel, imm-plan, imm-pr-diag, and imm-retire-stale-wrapper stay. package.json declares no bin field and the only historical PATH install is already handled by scripts/retire-stale-global-imm-wrappers.sh, so no supported installation breaks. The distinction that matters is trimmed versus gutted: both modules keep serving live callers, so the slice is wrong if either live projection changes shape.

acceptance.assertion: The named loop_contract child-output validators and plan_core fast-track and migration-signature helpers are absent, and bin/imm-activation-plan no longer exists.
imm-plan <plan-path> --json and imm_loop_action still return their current projection shapes, proving the modules were trimmed rather than gutted.
Every one of the eight retired command names still prints retirement guidance rather than an unknown-command error, and imm-kernel, imm-plan, imm-pr-diag, and imm-retire-stale-wrapper are unaffected.
